name: workflow-runner
summary: Repository-owned deterministic fan-out: classify task shape, dispatch concurrently, and collect JSONL results
description: Built-in slot for deterministic dispatch and collection using workflow_fanout.py when a task package calls for batch fan-out, parallel review, multiple perspectives, or review-fix convergence. The slot provides routing (workflow_route.py) and protocol documentation; routing, acceptance, and done/push gates stay in the main session. If the backend is unavailable, explicitly fall back to ordinary sidecars or team-loop.
triggers: batch parallel subagent tasks (fan-out / pipeline over items)
multidimensional parallel review (review dimensions -> verify -> synthesize)
independent perspectives followed by synthesis (judge panel / perspective sweep)
review-fix-reverify loops with deterministic control flow
